detail.deactivateHint: Kashe alamun kowane mai amfani da wannan ginin zai fita nan take.

detail.projectsHint: Abokan hulɗa suna zaɓar daga ayyuka masu aiki lokacin yin rijistar jagora; mai magana yana zuwa ga wannan magini.
detail.closeReferrals: Kusa don masu ba da shawara

protection.placeholder: Kwanakin kariya (ba komai = tsoho na duniya)
protection.hint: Kariyar Kwafi: kwanaki 1-3650, ko barin komai don amfani da tsohowar duniya daga Saituna. Canjin ya shafi sabbin rajista ne kawai - waɗanda ke da su suna kiyaye wa'adinsu.

matching.hint: Wanne cikakkun bayanai suna yin rajista guda biyu abokin ciniki iri ɗaya don aikin. Canje-canje suna shafi kwafin cak daga yanzu; kariya data kasance ba ta da tasiri.
